## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(backend): add endpoint to start a call`
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (and `make db-check` if `supabase/` changed)
- [ ] Bug fixes include a regression test; features include tests
- [ ] No API keys or real personal data in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or conventions changed (`AGENTS.md`, module READMEs)
- [ ] A teammate has reviewed it
